title: Finiteness of higher direct images of finite-type morphisms
statement:
Let $u:X\to Y$ be a
finite-type morphism
between finite-type schemes over a field, and let $F$ be a finite
constructible
sheaf with prime-to-characteristic
coefficients $\Lambda$.
Then $Ru_*F$ is bounded
constructible. If $u$ is separated, so is
$Ru_!F$. If its geometric
fibres have dimension at most $d$, the latter satisfies
$R^qu_!F=0$ for $q>2d$.

proof.text: Put F in degree zero. The single-functor homology is F in degree zero and zero elsewhere; transfer constructibility along the degree-zero homology isomorphism using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. This gives [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] with bounds [0,0]. Apply [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility] with the given structure morphisms and the equality supplied by f.IsOver. No separatedness is used.

proof.text: Under separatedness take c = compactSupportAmplitudeCompactification k Y f, the existing Nagata compactification supplied by [lem-dg-compact-support-amplitude] and [thm-nagata-compactification]. By [def-nagata-compactification], c.i is open and c.g is proper. The latter is finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism], hence its composite with the finite-type structure morphism of Y is finite type by [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Quasi-compactness of c.i follows from quasi-compactness of f and the compactification factorization. No additional Noetherian or comparison assumptions are needed for this candidate.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] to convert hF to the source constructibility predicate. Apply [lem-fin-extension-by-zero] to c.i and its closed complement, and convert back. Its extension by zero placed in degree zero is bounded constructible as in step 1. Map the coefficient unit from the field along each structure morphism; the same N is positive and annihilates the same finite ring. Apply [lem-fin-proper-bounded-constructible] to c.g and this degree-zero extension.

proof.text: By [def-amb-etale-compact-support], the very candidate in the conclusion is the exact derived open extension followed by proper derived pushforward. Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor identifies its extension of F[0] with (c.i_! F)[0]. Map this isomorphism by the proper pushforward. Homology functors carry it to isomorphisms, which preserve both constructibility and vanishing; transfer the conclusion of step 3. The statement specifies c itself, so no compactification-independence comparison is invoked.

proof.text: The source HasInvertibleExponent class asks for some positive annihilator, not the minimal additive exponent. The supplied N, its positivity, and (N : Λ) = 0, together with the unit on the field, give that class on Spec(k). Pull it back to Y. Apply [lem-dg-compact-support-amplitude] directly with the original geometric-fibre bound, F, q and the strict inequality. This gives exactly the third conjunct for the same compactification c.
